correctness.rationale: The two explicit 64-vertex 9-regular adjacency constructions independently reproduce local Smith valuation counts for all 63 reduced Laplacian factors. Python and C++ verifiers perform invertible modular row/column operations over 2^9 and 3^5, with every pivot valuation below precision. The exact spectrum gives the reduced determinant 2^147*3^27, so the verified 2- and 3-primary factors are complete; no extra primes can occur. The resulting elementary divisors give the asserted 4-torsion counts exactly.

value.rationale: These canonical isospectral distance-regular graphs agree in spanning-tree number and even the ordinary prime-field ranks known from Peeters, while their higher two-primary chip-firing torsion separates them by an exact factor four at exponent four. The full finite primary decompositions are natural integral invariants and a substantive benchmark for Cartesian-product critical-group behavior, not a parameter renaming or arbitrary filtered subset.
